pipeline.title: Pipeline Configuration
pipeline.description: Manage LLM models, prompts, and global settings for the course generation pipeline

stages.title: Pipeline Stages
stages.stage3Desc: Priority classification (optional - can use existing priorities)

tooltips.stage1: The model uploads user documents via tRPC and validates them: file format, size, and extension compliance. Files are temporarily stored for further processing.
tooltips.stage2: Docling converts documents to text, chunks them into sections, creates embeddings, and uploads vectors to Qdrant for semantic search.
tooltips.stage3: LLM analyzes document content and assigns priorities: CORE (key materials), IMPORTANT (supplementary), SUPPLEMENTARY (reference). Tournament classification is used for large sets.
tooltips.stage4: Multi-phase LLM analysis: course categorization (6 types), scope definition, expert analysis (critical for quality), result synthesis, and RAG context planning.
tooltips.stage5: Generates course structure: metadata, section hierarchy, V2 lesson specifications with learning objectives, duration, and complexity.
tooltips.stage6: Generates lesson content via Hybrid Map-Reduce-Refine: Planner creates outline, Expander fills sections, Assembler combines them, Smoother polishes. CLEV 3-judge panel evaluates quality.
tooltips.stage7: Creates multimedia enrichments for lessons: course covers, visual cards, videos, audio, quizzes, and presentations. Each enrichment type uses its own LLM model.

phases.stage_2_summarization: Summarizes document chunks to compress content while preserving key information for further analysis.
phases.stage_2_standard_en: Model for English documents with standard context size (<109K tokens). Optimized for typical document processing.
phases.stage_2_standard_ru: Model for Russian documents with standard context size (<109K tokens). Optimized for typical document processing.
phases.stage_2_extended_en: Model for English documents with extended context (>109K tokens). Handles large documents requiring more context.
phases.stage_2_extended_ru: Model for Russian documents with extended context (>109K tokens). Handles large documents requiring more context.
phases.stage_3_classification: Classifies documents by priority: CORE (essential materials), IMPORTANT (supplementary), SUPPLEMENTARY (reference). Uses tournament classification for large sets.
phases.stage_4_classification: Categorizes the course into one of 6 types and generates contextual language for subsequent phases.
phases.stage_4_scope: Defines course boundaries, target audience, prerequisites, and learning objectives.
phases.stage_4_expert: Deep expert analysis of content. Critical for output quality — uses more capable models.
phases.stage_4_synthesis: Synthesizes results from all analysis phases into a coherent course analysis.
phases.stage_4_standard_en: Model for English analysis with standard context (<109K tokens).
phases.stage_4_standard_ru: Model for Russian analysis with standard context (<109K tokens).
phases.stage_4_extended_en: Model for English analysis with extended context (>109K tokens).
phases.stage_4_extended_ru: Model for Russian analysis with extended context (>109K tokens).
phases.stage_5_sections: Generates course section hierarchy and lesson distribution based on analysis results.
phases.stage_5_metadata: Generates course metadata: title, description, tags, difficulty level, and estimated duration.
phases.stage_6_rag_planning: Plans RAG context retrieval for each lesson — determines which document chunks to use.
phases.stage_6_standard_en: Model for English lesson generation with standard context (<109K tokens).
phases.stage_6_standard_ru: Model for Russian lesson generation with standard context (<109K tokens).
phases.stage_6_extended_en: Model for English lesson generation with extended context (>109K tokens).
phases.stage_6_extended_ru: Model for Russian lesson generation with extended context (>109K tokens).
phases.stage_6_judge: CLEV quality evaluation system — 3 judges assess lesson content using OSCQR rubric.
phases.stage_7_cover: Generates course cover image using AI image generation.
phases.stage_7_card: Creates visual cards for lessons with key concepts and illustrations.
phases.stage_7_video: Generates educational video content for lessons.
phases.stage_7_audio: Creates audio narration for lesson content.
phases.stage_7_quiz: Generates interactive quizzes and knowledge checks based on lesson content.
phases.stage_7_presentation: Creates presentation slides summarizing lesson content.
